name: sf-delivery-brief
description: Turns a Jira ticket into a one-minute Salesforce solution brief grounded in your real org: onboarding (default org, role, Jira projects, project instructions), reuse-first impact analysis via read-only DX0, a plain 'how far I looked' coverage note, and 2-3 options with a recommendation. Bundles the Atlassian and DX0 connectors. Agents accelerate. Humans decide.
